title: Public hearing triage
prompt: A county team is reviewing testimony on a housing proposal. The practical question is which concerns need immediate discussion tonight and which can be logged for follow-up.

contributions.body: Immediate discussion should focus on displacement risk because that is where near-term harm is concentrated.
contributions.evidenceText: The hearing is most useful when it catches irreversible damage early.

contributions.body: Transit and school capacity should still be surfaced because they affect whether the proposal is viable at all.
contributions.evidenceText: A narrow housing-only lens misses downstream strain.

contributions.body: A routed digest should expose one minority concern clearly even if it is not the loudest testimony in the room.
contributions.evidenceText: Volume is not the same thing as decision relevance.

responses.body: That is the right priority, but the digest has to explain why quieter testimony made the cut or trust drops fast.
